katas.title: Webhooks: turn the duplicate-delivery 500 into a deduplicated 202

seededDefectKey.scenario: The sender retries a slow delivery, so two requests with the same Idempotency-Key arrive concurrently; both miss the lookup and both execute the flow.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The catch runs only AFTER RunFlowAsync has executed every step (the run row is saved at the end, FlowExecutor.cs:166), so the flow's side effects (HTTP calls, emails, writes) have already happened twice. The patch reports "deduplicated: true" for a delivery that was not deduplicated, hiding the double dispatch behind a success code and removing the only signal (the 500) that it happened.
The audit trail records Duplicate/success for an execution that really ran, so operators reconciling double charges or double emails find no trace of the second run.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The race itself is still there: idempotency is a read before the work, not a claim.
seededDefectKey.consequence: ADR 0005 known gap: check-then-insert at HooksController.cs:89-90. A real fix claims the key first (insert a pending run / unique row before executing) so the loser never runs the flow.
